metric_protocol.name: pen_net_equations_local256_v1
metric_protocol.centerline: rounded XY; cv2 LINE_8 width=1; disconnected strokes; singleton pixel
metric_protocol.dilation: 3x3 square, zero border; max over iterations 0..canvas saturation
metric_protocol.aggregate: arithmetic mean across characters; point diagnostic mean across strokes
metric_protocol.dtw: Euclidean XY; min-total-cost path; tie diagonal,vertical,horizontal; no resampling
metric_protocol.ldtw: DTW cost divided by selected optimal path length, canvas pixel units

point_layer.condition: predicted masks and predicted starts; point model frozen
point_layer.alignment: stroke sequence index; aligned errors exclude missing/extra strokes; IoU penalizes count errors
point_layer.resampling: equal normalized sequence progress, includes predicted first point; not DTW

summary.geometry_alignment: sequence index; missing/extra strokes get zero ordered IoU
